representation.name: Pseudobulk geometry and specificity
representation.description: Pairwise log-expression correlations and per-column specific genes
representation.shell_command:
python - "$(inputs.matrix.path)" results.tsv <<'PY'

import csv, math, sys
path=sys.argv[1]
out=sys.argv[2]
with open(path, newline="") as fh:
    rd=csv.reader(fh, delimiter="\t")
    header=next(rd)
    names=header[1:]
    cols=[[] for _ in names]
    rawcols=[[] for _ in names]
    genes=[]
    for row in rd:
        if len(row)<len(names)+1: continue
        try: vals=[float(x) for x in row[1:len(names)+1]]
        except: continue
        genes.append(row[0])
        for j,x in enumerate(vals):
            rawcols[j].append(x)
            cols[j].append(math.log1p(x))
def pearson(a,b):
    n=len(a); ma=sum(a)/n; mb=sum(b)/n
    va=sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a); vb=sum((x-mb)**2 for x in b)
    return sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x,y in zip(a,b))/math.sqrt(va*vb) if va and vb else 0.0
def ranks(a):
    order=sorted(range(len(a)), key=lambda i:a[i])
    r=[0.0]*len(a); k=0
    while k<len(order):
        l=k+1
        while l<len(order) and a[order[l]]==a[order[k]]: l+=1
        rv=(k+l-1)/2.0
        for z in range(k,l): r[order[z]]=rv
        k=l
    return r
rcols=[ranks(x) for x in cols]
with open(out,"w",newline="") as fo:
    w=csv.writer(fo,delimiter="\t",lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["section","sample1","sample2","value","detail"])
    for i in range(len(names)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
            w.writerow(["pearson_log1p",names[i],names[j],f"{pearson(cols[i],cols[j]):.8f}",""])
            w.writerow(["spearman_log1p",names[i],names[j],f"{pearson(rcols[i],rcols[j]):.8f}",""])
    for i,nm in enumerate(names):
        vals=[(pearson(cols[i],cols[j]),names[j]) for j in range(len(names)) if j!=i]
        vals.sort(reverse=True)
        w.writerow(["nearest_pearson",nm,vals[0][1],f"{vals[0][0]:.8f}",",".join(f"{b}:{a:.4f}" for a,b in vals[:5])])
        svals=[(pearson(rcols[i],rcols[j]),names[j]) for j in range(len(names)) if j!=i]
        svals.sort(reverse=True)
        w.writerow(["nearest_spearman",nm,svals[0][1],f"{svals[0][0]:.8f}",",".join(f"{b}:{a:.4f}" for a,b in svals[:5])])
    for i,nm in enumerate(names):
        scores=[]
        for g in range(len(genes)):
            x=rawcols[i][g]
            others=[rawcols[j][g] for j in range(len(names)) if j!=i]
            mo=sum(others)/len(others)
            mx=max(others)
            spec=math.log2((x+0.1)/(mo+0.1))
            scores.append((spec,x/(mx+0.1),x,genes[g]))
        scores.sort(reverse=True)
        for rank,(spec,ratio,x,gene) in enumerate(scores[:40],1):
            w.writerow(["specific_gene",nm,gene,f"{spec:.8f}",f"rank={rank};expr={x:.6g};vsmax={ratio:.6g}"])

PY

representation.name: Inspect BLAG annotation overlap
representation.shell_command:
python - "$(inputs.matrix.path)" "$(inputs.gff.path)" overlap.tsv <<'PY'

import csv,re,sys
matrix,gff,out=sys.argv[1:4]
with open(matrix,newline="") as f:
    r=csv.reader(f,delimiter="\t"); next(r)
    genes={row[0] for row in r if row}
hits={}
seen_ids=set()
with open(gff,errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line or line[0]=="#": continue
        p=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(p)<9: continue
        attr=p[8]
        ids=set(re.findall(r"BLAG[0-9A-Za-z_.-]+",attr))
        for x in ids:
            x=x.split(":")[-1]
            seen_ids.add(x)
            if x in genes:
                hits.setdefault(x,set()).add(attr)
with open(out,"w") as f:
    f.write("metric\tvalue\tdetail\n")
    f.write("matrix_gene_count\t%d\t\n"%len(genes))
    f.write("gff_BLAG_id_count\t%d\t\n"%len(seen_ids))
    f.write("intersection_count\t%d\t\n"%len(hits))
    for g in sorted(hits)[:500]:
        f.write("match\t%s\t%s\n"%(g," | ".join(sorted(hits[g]))))

import csv,collections,sys
inp,out=sys.argv[1:3]
with open(inp,newline="") as f:
 r=csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t")
 a=collections.Counter(); b=collections.Counter()
 for row in r:
  a[row["cell_type"]]+=1; b[row["broad_cell_type"]]+=1
with open(out,"w") as f:
 f.write("field\tlabel\tcells\n")
 for k,v in sorted(a.items()): f.write("cell_type\t%s\t%d\n"%(k,v))
 for k,v in sorted(b.items()): f.write("broad_cell_type\t%s\t%d\n"%(k,v))
